data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Replace call-count sentinel test with BEHAVIORAL RED test. RED test design: (a) BEFORE wiring _audit_dso_id_label_writes into apply(): test_unauthorized_leaf_writes_dso_id_label_silently_succeeds — invoke apply() with mutation from unauthorized leaf that writes dso-id label → no exception, write proceeds (this is the RED state). (b) AFTER wiring: test_unauthorized_leaf_writes_dso_id_label_raises_through_apply — invoke apply() with same mutation → DsoIdLabelWriteError propagates through apply(). The behavioral observation (raise vs no-raise through apply()) is the RED-to-GREEN signal; do NOT use a call-count sentinel on the internal helper. Sentinel test demoted to supplementary — primary correctness assertion is via apply() integration.
